Find objects related to a given object via reference fields.

Traverses relationships following reference fields (*_ref, *_refs) up to a specified depth.
Supports filtering by relationship type.


  Find all related objects (depth 1)
  zqk object related BLI-626
  Find related objects up to depth 3
  zqk object related BLI-626 --depth 3
  Find objects related via specific relationship type
  zqk object related BLI-626 --relationship priority_plan_ref
  Output as JSON
  zqk object related BLI-626 --format json

Usage:
  zqk object related <id> [flags]

Flags:
      --depth int             Maximum depth to traverse relationships (default: 1) (default 1)
      --relationship string   Filter by specific relationship type (e.g., priority_plan_ref)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
